desc:
🥊 Punch, Grab & Throw Ragdolls Out of the Ring! 🥊
Fight as YOUR OWN avatar with full ragdoll physics. Knock everyone out of the ring. Last one standing wins!

⚡ Abilities (9)
Dash, Tackle, Battle Cry, Anchor, Stomp, Bulk Up, Sugar Rush, Second Wind, Slime Ball

🏟️ 6 Arenas
Boxing Ring, The Grinder, Elevators, Subway, Water Tower, Baseplate

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
🥊 Punch (Click), Grab (Hold Right Click, let go to throw), Lift (Shift)
🌀 Use your ability with Q!
💰 Earn coins every match and unlock new abilities
👥 Vote for Solos, Duos, Trios, Hot Potato, Chain Gang or Protect the King!

🎁 CODES: RELEASE, NEWGAME
👍 Redeem them for free coins, then give us a 👍 LIKE and ⭐ FAVORITE!

🔔 FOLLOW and FAVORITE for the latest UPDATES! 🔔
